glosses: to commemorate, to mark, to memorialize, to immortalize (to honor the memory of someone or something with a ceremony or object)
to commemorate, to mark, to memorialize, to immortalize (to serve as a memorial to someone or something)

examples.text: Wielu z górali postanowiło upamiętnić spotkanie z niepospolitym gościem pamiątkową fotką

glosses: To honour the memory of someone or something with a ceremony or object.

examples.text: On November 11th we commemorate the fallen with a march.

On the anniversary of Korczak's murder, Israel commemorated him with a special postal issue. As a stamp collector and philatelic columnist, it pleased me greatly when other countries followed Israel's example in honoring him.

glosses: To serve as a memorial to someone or something.

examples.text: In almost all the Psalms of praise, we find the preceding distress and afflictions […] first pathetically commemorat.

glosses: To provide a memorial for someone; to commemorate.

examples.text: In this passage, Andromaque sees Astyanax only through the memorializing lens of his attribution to Hector, his status as "gage."

President Emmanuel Macron decided this summer that 46 years after her death, Baker would become only the sixth woman to be memorialised in the Panthéon in a ceremony on 30 November – the anniversary of the marriage to Jean Lion that allowed her to acquire French nationality.

glosses: To convert (someone’s profile) into a memorial site/page (e.g. on Facebook).

examples.text: Facebook says people with memorialized accounts do not appear in advertisements or birthday reminders on the site and are also excluded from the People You May Know list of friend suggestions.

glosses: To create a written record of a meeting or conversation.

examples.text: Most of the time, the National Security Council — the foreign policy arm of the White House — memorializes presidential phone or video calls with foreign heads of state on the so-called TNet system, the officials said.

glosses: To petition with a memorial, or statement of facts.

examples.text: Why, you'll—you'll ask till they tell you. Then you'll memorialize that Department (according to regular forms which you'll find out) for leave to memorialize this Department.

glosses: Rappeler par une cérémonie, une plaque de commémoration ou un autre objet, le souvenir d’une personne ou d’un fait.

examples.text: Fraîchement réinvesti, Emmanuel Macron a commémoré, dimanche à Paris, la victoire du 8 mai 1945 des Alliés sur l’Allemagne nazie.
Comme chaque année, les batailles de la Chipotte seront commémorées le dernier dimanche d'août.

glosses: ricordare un personaggio o un avvenimento in forma pubblica e in modo solenne
